title: Measurable Does Not Imply Transportable: A Prospective Audit of Model Explanations in Multi-Year Field Trials
abstract: arXiv:2611.25692v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model explanations are increasingly used as scientific evidence, yet it remains unclear what they license scientists to conclude beyond the data on which they were constructed. When a fine-grained explanation fails to replicate, the failure may be attributed to noisy measurement of its target, raising a fundamental question: does reliable measurement imply a reproducible explanation? We test this directly. We formalize prospective explanation transportability: the extent to which an explanation learned from past data is recovered in a genuinely future context. This property is distinct from feature importance and measurement reliability. Using multi-year Genomes-to-Fields maize trials, where each new year is a real future context rather than a random resample, we evaluate 16 agronomically interpretable environmental concepts across five forward splits and one prospectively locked test year. translated_title: 可测量并不意味着可迁移：多年田间试验中模型解释的前瞻性审计
translated_abstract: 模型解释日益被用作科学证据，然而它们能让科学家在构建解释所用的数据之外得出何种结论，仍不明确。当细粒度的解释无法复现时，这种失败可能被归因于对其目标的噪声测量，由此引出一个根本性问题：可靠的测量是否意味着可复现的解释？我们对此进行了直接检验。我们形式化了“前瞻性解释可迁移性”这一概念：即从过去数据中学到的解释在真正未来情境中被恢复的程度。这一属性有别于特征重要性和测量可靠性。利用多年份的“基因组到田地”玉米田间试验——其中每个新年份都是真实的未来情境，而非随机重采样——我们在五个前向划分和一个前瞻性锁定的测试年份上评估了16个具有农学可解释性的环境概念。粗粒度的环境层面解释能够迁移（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文形式化了“前瞻性解释可迁移性”这一新概念，并通过多年玉米田间试验证明：可靠的测量并不保证解释能在真正未来的情境中复现，这一属性独立于特征重要性和测量可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes "prospective explanation transportability" and uses multi-year Genomes-to-Fields maize trials to show that reliable measurement does not imply a reproducible explanation in genuinely future contexts, a property distinct from feature importance and measurement reliability.
